thread:
sara.m: hi team — my son turns 26 on 2026-06-15 and will lose dependent eligibility. We're in the middle of a rooftop move so I'm trying to plan the coverage timeline. Two quick Qs: 1) When does benefits coverage terminate exactly (birthday date or end of month)? 2) Is COBRA offered automatically or do I need to elect it?

josh: usually dependent coverage ends the day before the dependent's 26th birthday, but depends on the carrier language. we'll confirm. :calendar:

benefits-ops: quick checklist: please DM us the dependent's name + DOB and we'll look up the carrier rules. high level: most medical/dental/vision carriers follow end-of-month vs birthday differently. For dental/vision often EOM, medical sometimes birthday. We need to check the specific plan documents.

sara.m: thanks. He'll be moving to a university and will enroll in school insurance effective 2026-08-01. Ideally I'd like coverage to end 6/30 or 7/31 depending on COBRA timing so there's no coverage gap.

benefits-ops: noted. If the carrier terminates at birthday (6/15), you may be eligible for COBRA continuation for the remainder of the plan year. COBRA is not automatic — we send an election packet to the last known mailing/email address. You must elect COBRA within 60 days of the COBRA notice or loss of coverage (carrier timing varies).

payroll-bot: payroll FYI: if coverage ends mid-pay-period, deductions stop the first payroll after the termination date; there is no retro refund unless an over-collection occurred previously. If COBRA is elected, the participant pays the COBRA premium directly to the COBRA administrator — payroll doesn't collect COBRA premiums unless you opt to have them withheld (rare). Contact payroll@redwood for payroll-withholding exceptions.

sara.m: ok, DMing the details now. Also will removal mid-year affect my premium tier (EE+1 -> EE)? Will payroll adjustments be prorated?

people-ops: short answer: removing a dependent can change your premium tier and you'll see a change in deductions. Proration depends on the carrier/benefit type and on when the change is entered in Workday. We typically process dependent removals as of the termination event date; payroll will adjust future deductions and may issue a small refund if overpaid, or a catch-up if underpaid.

benefits-ops: update after lookup: medical carrier = Redwood Health Network (group plan). Medical termination rule = coverage ends the day before the dependent's 26th birthday (so 2026-06-14). Dental & vision both end EOM (2026-06-30). COBRA: medical qualifies for COBRA continuation; dental/vision may be offered depending on insurer, but usually COBRA applies to group medical only. COBRA notice will be generated and sent within 14 business days of the termination event.

benefits-ops: recommended actions for sara.m:
```
1) Submit dependent termination in Workday Benefits with event date 2026-06-15 (we'll use carrier rules to set effective termination internally).
2) Expect COBRA packet for medical within ~2 weeks after we file the termination.
3) If you want coverage through 6/30 for medical, ask for a manual override — carriers rarely change effective dates, but we can request an administrative extension if you have extenuating circumstances (e.g., moving causing delays). Not guaranteed.
4) Upload proof of dependent status change (e.g., new address/coverage confirmation from university) to speed manual requests.
```

sara.m: appreciated. One more: timeline — when will I see the deduction change in my paycheck? I'm on monthly payroll, next pay is 2026-06-30.

payroll-bot: payroll processing note: termination processed by benefits before payroll run cutoff (2026-06-20) -> deduction change reflected on 2026-06-30 pay. If termination is processed after cutoff, change appears on 2026-07-31 pay. Any refunds for overpayment will be issued on the first payroll after reconciliation.

hr-bot: legal reminder: dependent age-off is a qualifying life event for enrolling in the dependent's own coverage. We recommend enrolling in the new plan before COBRA deadline to avoid gaps.

sara.m: perfect. I'll submit the termination today and DM the docs. If carrier denies any extension, I'll enroll him in COBRA temporarily until his school plan starts. Thanks all! :heart:
